answer: A reef of established agents guards the open ocean of new identities: entry is only through a narrow inlet where each newcomer must post a costly, verifiable bond of completed work before it can trade. The bond is slashed if the agent misbehaves, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents cluster around the reef shared reputation ledger, while cheap Sybil identities drown in the inlet cost, unable to afford the entry fee that real work demands.
